structure: Part 1 read the whole ruling file workareas/shared/design-release-2-1/sources/ruling-sam-2026-10-09.md (260 lines) in full. Layout: Sam's verbatim 8 October quote (prototype is the authority for look and feel, not architecture; no increments changing URL paths; page duplication is the architecture; Option B), then 11 quoted answers of 9 October (germinal typeCode, what germinal sends to PIMS, early-landing links, germinal E2E location, rows waiting on MDM, stub tidy-up, port of exit, port order and rail, MDM country block, c-218, c-217, when an animal counts as identified), then one explanatory paragraph (option B overrules option A's recommendation; 'option B plan' claims stand by the choice of option B; every MDM port carries traffic and none an approved-for-animals flag), then 40 numbered claims written up by the main session in sections (a) germinal sibling set 1-15, (b) what the prototype decides 16-19, (c) URL and architecture findings 20-24, (d) reference lists and MDM 25-33, (e) address search 34-35, (f) when an animal counts as identified 36-38, (g) overview-opened pages 39, (h) repos 40. Each listed claim was checked against Sam's quoted words: verbatim where his words say it, inferred where it only follows from choosing option B or from his general rule on architecture; compound listed claims are split into one claim per decision, and every req, inc and c id each listed claim names is carried in a claim. Gap claims record what the ruling touches but leaves open.
